notes.title: Notice to the mod Community
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Lee Hyung Joo, producer of Chrono Ark.

Recently, some incidents occurred in the Chinese modding community that may have caused discomfort among members, and I want to take this opportunity to explain the situation and express my apologies.

During a recent disagreement with a major contributor in the Chinese mod community, a programmer from Alfine acted independently, displaying inappropriate behavior and issuing a 24-hour ban to two mod creators without prior discussion. This led some mod creators to voluntarily remove their mods, causing disappointment and discomfort within the mod community. I deeply apologize for the distress this has caused.

As the producer of Chrono Ark, I take full responsibility for this incident, and I am committed to doing everything possible to prevent similar situations from happening in the future. We have decided to impose a ban on the programmer within the community, and internally we are strengthening our guidelines for communication with players.

Additionally, we pledge to ensure that future updates to Chrono Ark consider compatibility with existing mods to avoid conflicts. We hope this will allow mod creators to continue their work with confidence.

Thank you once again for your understanding and support.

Chrono Ark was bound to grab an audience's attention. Its visuals, which feature colorful Persona 5 style character portraits, do a good job of catching the eye on their own. But it's the game's design concept that really helps it stick out. In an era where PC players can't seem to get enough of card games (see: Balatro and Slay the Spire 2) and roguelikes (see: Hades 2), Chrono Ark combines both of those genres with RPG game party building and storytelling in order to offer players something they seem to be very excited to dig into.

[h3]Thoughts on Chrono Ark Development[/h3]
This is only my personal story as the 'Developer Hyung-Ju Lee', and it's not related to the game, so there's no need for you to read it.

Hello everyone. I am Hyung-Ju Lee, a developer of Chrono Ark and alfine.

It's been a long journey.
After 3 years of development and 4 years of Early Access, Chrono Ark is finally complete.

Actually, Chrono Ark is my 2nd project.

What was the first project?
Well... it was a failed project.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FDAvURHrU0A

This first project, which I programmed in my third year of high school, failed. I was devastated and spent 1 year of doing nothing, but then I finally decided to give game development one last try, which led to 'Chrono Ark'.

When I first started developing Chrono Ark, I was working part-time at a convenience store. I worked on the game in an unheated alcove, with a laptop on the floor and a blanket over my head, with nothing but a dream to make a fun game once more.

After a long development period, there were only two team members remaining when we launched the game in Early Access, including myself.

We launched the game in Early Access as a 2-member team, and then used the profits to recruit more team members and develop the game further... In the midst of it all, I became ambitious and wanted to include a lot of things, so I tried this and that. 
This process delayed the game by a lot.

And finally! Chrono Ark is now officially released.

I feel a little older now.

I recognize that there was both good and bad updates during the development of Chrono Ark.

I learned what people like, what people don't like, why the development period was so delayed, and what I can do well.
Based on my experience in developing Chrono Ark, I want to make an even better next game!

Thank you.

Hello everyone, this is Hyung-Ju Lee from AlFine.
Currently, the Fate episode is no longer viewable and will no longer be developed within Chrono Ark.
This is because the content of the story has changed from our original plan.
At the time when we decided to develop the Fate episode, we were planning to end the main story of Chrono Ark without explaining anything and reveal the details later in the Fate episode. However, much of the story that was planned to be in the Fate episode has already been added to the main story, so the Fate episode has no longer become vital to understanding the story.
Although the Fate episode was removed from the game, the setting or overall flow of the story have not changed.

However, we are still willing to develop the Fate episode as a standalone game.
Mystery, Closed Circle, Death Game, Detective, Virtual Reality.
The Fate episode was planned to be a very interesting story featuring unusual murder cases, ingenious tricks, and the paths that the Investigators took in the past.
However, since the need for the Fate episode has been diminished in the current story of Chrono Ark, it will have to wait until the next opportunity.

Thank you for your attention.

notes.title: Chrono Ark EA 1.9999 - New World

English

Hello everyone, I am Hyung-Ju Lee, the lead developer of Chrono Ark.
Chrono Ark has been updated to version EA 1.99999!

[h2]What is "EA 1.99999"?[/h2]
First of all, I would like to apologize for postponing the official release to next year early-mid season. 
However, we are spending a lot of time making the game quality as good as it can be.
Our original plan was to release the 2.0 update along with the ending, but we realized finishing the ending would push the update period too far. Therefore, we decided to split the story and update the game now.
This means we are planning to finish the main story in the next 2.0 update.
I sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to this year’s official release.


Below are the main features of the EA 1.99999 update.


[h2]The Final Story Arc[/h2]
[b]Azar is trying to end the loop to create a new world.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/89731d296daa7a24ad5896fe16e2f27a919f552e.gif[/img]

This update contains story content until just before the ending.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

- Added Challenge "Quick Building".
“Quick Building” is a challenge that lets you start from a campfire in the second area ‘Bloody Park’. This shortens playtime significantly, but you will be shorter on items than a regular playthrough, and this challenge will cost “5 Credits” to play. 
- Added 3 new items.
- Improved the Result Screen UI

- Fixed the game so that if you enter soulstones into the vending machines but do not enter Crimson Wilderness, you will get your soulstones back.

Hello, Fellow Arkers! Chrono Ark EA 1.82 Beta has been updated!
 
In this 1.82 update, the Crimson Wilderness stage has been added to the game.
The Crimson Wilderness can be accessed in the Bloody Park Campfire as an alternative to stage 2-2.  
However, there are a [b]few seeecrets![/b] you need to find if you want to enter.
 
[h3]Crimson Wilderness Introduction[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/6041dfa2a624e7705066d91b087cc5dfe4101f67.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/c65ffb0c7f7a4a1566ec7a2b5b0b2c875661cdc5.png[/img]

A giant tree scatters beautiful red blossoms across the land. The Crimson Wilderness is a lawless wasteland where people gather to indulge in duels and romanticism. This region is hidden deep within the Twisted Land, and for some reason, all of the residents seem to know that the world is looping.
As duel fanatics, they will mercilessly attack Lucy and her crew for invading their territory.  

The Crimson Wilderness is a hidden stage, so it cannot be accessed by normal means.  Look for secrets within the Twisted Land to enter the Crimson Wilderness.

[h3]Characteristics of the Crimson Wilderness[/h3]

The Crimson Wilderness consists of 3 [b]extremely difficult[/b] battles.
There is a campfire that you can access at any time. At the end of each battle, all of your party members will revive and restore some health.
Don't be afraid to have a few party members faint in order to win.
There are also a few items that can only be obtained in the Crimson Wilderness.
 
 
[h3]The Crimson Wilderness is eagerly awaiting your challenge.[h3]

notes.title: Chrono Ark EA 1.7 – Update: Crossroads
notes.notes:
Hello, Fellow Arkers! Chrono Ark has officially been updated with v1.7 content.

In this new update, we have added a large amount of player choices outside of battle.
This update provides many new ways to strengthen your party, and one of the main methods is our new Skill Upgrade system!
There are also many new monsters, new items, and new skills to seek out.
All system changes have been completed with this update, and all that’s left is to keep adding more content!

A huge thanks to all the beta players who reported bugs and provided valuable playtest feedback.

First of all, let’s look at what has changed since v1.63.

[h1]Improved Field Objects[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/036d3d2f4a3a8ae70f2e674f33217d982fe96b58.gif[/img]
Field objects have been completely reworked, and there are now 42 events implemented in the game.
Not all event objects have been implemented, and there will be more to come in future updates.
Along with the massive increase in object count, there are now many new ways to obtain items as well as a variety of new items.
 
[h1]Addition of Choices[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/30a69999876b7d3d0aee744129468df26f4bde0d.gif[/img]
When obtaining lower-tier equipment, there are now many cases where you can pick between 2 displayed items.
There are also many cases where you can make a choice between 2 Relics.
Hopefully this will help you obtain items that are beneficial to your team composition.
 
[h1]Skill Upgrades[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/92d4b281c6046875c58bdbdb8d8ee39246e6797a.gif[/img]
You can now apply special effects on your teammates’ skills.

[list]
[*] Reworked event objects.
[*] Improved UI.

This is implemented so that the game forces less choices upon newer players who are unfamiliar with the game.
[*] Equipment/Relics can now be combined in the campfire.

notes.notes:
Hello, Fellow Arkers!
I am Hyung Ju Lee, the leading developer of Chrono Ark.

Let me briefly introduce the upcoming v1.7 update that covers the Twisted Land.
(The actual content might differ from the peek.)

[h2]1. Object Improvement[/h2]
This is the main improvement of the Twisted Land update and includes the most changes.
First of all, the player could not choose the objects that appeared on the field. The number of them was also not that many.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/36e6c96b50a6ccdb4f07ef896b6d9a1729cbf59c.png[/img]

After the Twisted Land update, the player can choose one out of two for all event objects except the shops and chest rooms.
This adjustment has been made to give the player more choices to create more unique gameplays as they insist.
We plan to add more objects to the previous pool of less than 10 to create additional variables during the gameplay. There will be new mechanics added for this.
Also, you can combine items at the campfire instead of the blacksmith to lower the dependency on the blacksmith.


[h3]Object Summary[/h3]
There will be about [b]40[/b] event objects. Let's go over some of them briefly.

[b]The Fallen Library[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/31cfbe3bbae757102497896041a336d7687ed60a.png[/img]
 - You can enchant equipment up to 2 times.
There are no other functions like changing a skill book into a scroll.
This is an example where the purpose of previous objects has become more straightforward and more transparent.

[b]The Maid’s Quarter[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/b146c08c412a75eb9ac84542f28be01f17107c66.png[/img]
 - You can battle with maids and receive a skill book - Healing 101.
It is a battle object that can only be encountered at Stage 1.
battle objects have more serious difficulty compared to a normal encounter. Sometimes, an [b]Elite Monster for the Object[/b] can appear.
Also, you cannot gain a Soulstone from the special battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/f5cbb43625b424582d15bd665b17abafd4f5f1ef.png[/img]
(New Monster added to the previous Stages)

[b]Sanctum of Sword of the Forest[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/58395fb591810d2fe0551e19e568f57442e35499.png[/img]
 - A sanctum with graves of Sir Dorchis from the older generations.
 - You can pull out equipment, [b]Sword of the Forest[/b].
 - The only boss of this Stage will always be 'Sir Dorchi.'
It is a special object that only appears after Stage 1-2, where you complete the Sir Dorchi quest.
There are objects where you can receive a fixed reward with a higher risk under specific conditions.
Of course, Sir Dorchi will no longer appear as a regular boss as this new event object is added. It will be more challenging to beat Sir Dorchi.

[b]Casino[/b]
 - You can play a minigame by pressing a key at the right timing to receive an item.

[b]The Trials[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/7ac0ca2ea41d329d709f3b02718ad43f203fc0ec.png[/img]
Five objects are counted as The Trials in the Twisted Land. They appear randomly as other objects do.
The Trials are the objects to challenge your party. There is no risk of trying the Trials since the player will return to the pre-battle moment after the battle. However, the Trials are tricky objects to pass that require every strategy you can use.

[b]Trial of Wisdom[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/7509d276e34a81e887942ecb7ebdfcf934796871.png[/img]
- Challenge your deck and receive the reward if passed.
The player will be able to choose one of the conditions below. 
(Except Lucy's skills)
 - Pass if the sum of the costs of 6 skills drawn
 - Pass if you draw 2+ skills that apply Pain Debuff out of 6 skills drawn 
 There are various conditions like the above.

[b]Trial of Power[/b]
 - The player enters a battle with an enemy that doesn't have HP nor take any action. 
 - Pass if the total damage dealt for three turns is above a certain amount.
The maximum total damage dealt will be recorded after every Trial of Power.

[b]Trial of Time[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/d918eae8bb411c4545a8963c8c7fa98d65b82d63.png[/img]
- Trial of Time activates when the player enters a battle with a boss of the Stage. 
- Pass if the player defeats the boss in a certain amount of time.
- The timer doesn't tick during the attack effect or the enemy turn.
As we have mentioned before, The Trials are one of the event objects. All objects will have two choices for the player to choose from. You can decide to pick Trial of Time if you want a more challenging boss battle. Otherwise, you can go with another Trial if you're going to play the game while thinking carefully. We have decided to give the player choices to build unique and fun objects depending on their playstyle. This allows the game to have a variety of designs and fun on the objects.

[b]Trial of Courage[/b]
- Pass if the player survives for three turns from powerful attack moves.

[b]Trial of Chaos[/b]
- Pass if you meet a special condition during the next battle.


 Due to the object improvements, there will be minor changes on obtaining items(potions, equipment, relics, Golden Skill Book, etc.) due to the object improvements. There will be new unique items added like Golden Apple.

[h2]3. The Sanctuary[/h2]
Stage 4, The Sanctuary, will go through adjustments due to the object improvements.
The Sanctuary will be the Stage where the player can use the accumulated keys and Gold and collect even more items.



[h2]4. Active Items[/h2]
There will be various elements added that the player can utilize to build the team by adding multiple objects.
Active items are one of them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/94b21a434e90a666b0ce86f05a530c1d7ce8d370.png[/img]
Active items are items that the player can use during combat. They can be used for a certain number and are rechargeable.
Active items can be activated when you equip them at the right side of the Inventory slot.
Lucy's Necklace and Charon's Soul Thurible will be regarded as special items to be used from the Inventory as before.
Active items' effects can vary from Draw 1 skill or Restore 1 Mana to dealing damage to an enemy depending on current active buffs. We will add some mechanics to the game where the player can play around with certain active items.

[h2]5. Lucy’s Curse Skill[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/2bc55c47ce9b41d50ce9db51c81a487b3ed0aa20.png[/img]
Some new objects can expose the player to various risks.
One of them is Lucy's Curse Skill.
Heavy Bag - Cost 5 Mana. It cannot be Played.
Lousy Reflex - Exclude, Cannot be Played, Place this skill at the top of the deck at the start of each battle.
We will add various other Curse Skills.

[h2]6. Skill Upgrade & Downgrade[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/c6be8e5178b0df8c0fa26fceb7256afbbe6a5832.png[/img]
The player can give a special effect to skills for the run by upgrading them.
 - Cost one more Mana but cast twice.
 - (Can be upgraded if Pressel is in the party) 50% bonus effect if drawn by Prophecy.
 - (Can be upgraded if Charon is in the party) Give one stack of Encroachment to a target.
We  will add various skill upgrade effects other than the above.
However, skills can be Cursed and get downgraded.
- Increase Count by 1.
- Remove Swiftness.
- Cost one more Mana.
- Give Exclude.
Skills that are upgraded or downgraded cannot be discarded in a usual way. They also cannot become a Fixed Ability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/659ef96707a798106cef6882189c580cf46831e5.png[/img]

[h2]7. Potion Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/6517df6cb7c6b3d214fcd8b31805eb76b1cd9912.png[/img]
Potion Identification and Potions that increase a particular ability are removed.
Potions have a more substantial effect overall. They are now more suitable in an emergency. A variety of potions are added.
The player can now only use at most three potions in a battle. 
This limit is due to the more substantial effects of potions. Now the player can use other new consumables or active items, so we had to [b]balance out[/b] the overall game difficulty on the deck, party, and active items.
New potion mechanics are designed to maintain the game balance and be more flexible than capping the number of potions in the Inventory.


There will be new elements such as event objects and special items like Golden Apple that buff a specific ability for the run since the buff potions are removed.

There are many minor changes for this update, but please understand us for not going through all of them!

notes.title: Feedback Reports from the Community and Update Plans
notes.notes:
[h3]1. “I have played Chrono Ark: Fate and the genre is too different from the original game and has too much play time!”[/h3]

[b]Alternative Solution: The game is now clearable without watching the ending of Chrono Ark: Fate[/b]
The game currently plays Lucy’s story where the Prologue of Chrono Ark: Fate is supposed to be.
Chrono Ark: Fate can be unlocked and viewed under a certain condition.


Our first intention was to make players watch the [b]Prologue only[/b] for Chrono Ark: Fate and let them choose to watch the rest. Now you can choose whether to choose to watch the Prologue or not.


We considered that players would remain curious about the rest of the story after clearing the game without watching Chrono Ark: Fate. So, we decided not to force everyone to go through the plots.

The reason why we decided to build Chrono Ark: Fate is because I, as a director, personally do not like resolving remaining questions into a separate series.


There are many short but emotional stories about Lucy to come. Please wait for them to be added patiently.


Also, new PV and trailer for Chrono Ark are planned to be added around the time the second series of Chrono Ark: Fate is on!



[h3]2. “Please Balance out the Skills!”[/h3]

[b]We are planning massive buffs and nerfs.[/b]

"Charon’s skill set is just mediocre."
- Charon will receive her Rare skill. Her new core mechanic will be upgraded while dealing additional damage when Soul Stigma is applied to the target.

​
"Azar’s Illusion Flash is too hard to use. Fantasy is too overpowered."
- We will nerf Fantasy and remove the Count effect from Azar’s Illusion Flash.

"Hein depends on Merciless Explosion. His other skills sucks with low Accuracy. It’s impossible to use Hein without Merciless Explostion."
- We will buff Hein’s skills based on Merciless Explosion’s health-based self-harming mechanic. We will also add extra effects to skills such as Tear Up and Assault Slash to suggest a new concept to Hein players.

"Most of the Rare skills of Silverstein, Narhan, and most of the Healers suck."
- We will improve on all Rare skills mentioned above..

​
"Lian and Phoenix don’t have any Draw Skills?"
- We will add them for both.

​

Others:

Selena and Helia’s Blessing-based skills - Planned to be buffed

Lian’s Relentless Swipe - Planned to be nerfed

Trisha - Planned to fix Blink Stab’s OTK mechanic. Planned to improve on ‘boring’ skills.

Miss Chain’s Fire Ground - Planned to be buffed
​


Everything that are mentioned above is our next goal. We will update ASAP!

[b]Chrono Ark Story: Fate[/b]
Hello, fellow Arkers! 
We have made a lot of progress on the storyline.

The storyline of Chrono Ark Story: Fate is carried out in a way that two of the main characters ‘Lucy’ and ‘Azar’ develop their own stories.
The Chrono Ark Story: Fate update will feature ‘Azar’’s story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/0e7d69b5620b2251c94f99736feee4a775768036.png[/img]

We’ve been brainstorming many ideas regarding the storyline since the early development of Chrono Ark, which has consisted of many sleepless nights spent planning how each character would play out in accordance with the main storyline.
We drew inspiration from 'Danganronpa' and have learned a lot from its unique story-oriented gameplay.
You may find some resemblances to it along your Chrono Ark journey. 
However, we focused on developing our own vibe into the game since Chrono Ark has more dynamic features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/e78ac7f3d9e2588b4f3ae1746a8aa0f043b537e3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/afb53a62d709f296f0e37a3a19bed0c3eb40bd56.png[/img]


There will be around 10 episodes including the Prologue in Chrono Ark Story: Fate. This update will only include the Prologue.
We also have polished the previous storyline to make it more interesting.
Due to this decision, all storyline progress will be reset.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/05a35a8f6f942de29f1b41fc0f61eba6216252df.gif[/img]

[b]The Meaning Behind Chrono Ark’s Story[/b]
We are aiming to develop Chrono Ark as a game worth purchasing for its storyline.
Many of the added features, including Hope Mode, were intended to lower any difficulties so that players could instead focus on the storyline.
Don’t worry, the storyline will not interfere with the immersiveness of Chrono Ark’s roguelike features.
We still deeply believe that Chrono Ark is a roguelike video game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/9023d0cf873722f305dc7e108ee16a5cd03a933b.gif[/img]

[b]About Roguelike[/b]
There will be new playable characters, addition and improvement of building type objects, new stages, and challenges once the storyline is added to the game.
This update has been delayed due to creating a completely new system for Chrono Ark Story: Fate, as well as new illustrations of many characters.
Now that the foundation is complete to some extent, we are expecting to work more efficiently regarding following updates.

[b]Scenario[/b]
"Linuj" has joined our team as a scenario writer.

[b]New Character Teasers[/b]
Characters will be released next Monday, Wednesday and Friday before the update!

We're happy to announce that Chrono Ark EA v1.2 has been released.

Us Chrono Ark devs don't speak English very well. Also, there are so many small bits here and there being added, modified, and removed in the same day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/7f613a6d5732f7a88c749be77bbf4ce7f3831205.png[/img]

notes.title: Chrono Ark Early Access 1.1 Updated!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/0866559182c6d6c18eed2e409c6686f734c37e03.png[/img]

What's up, everybody!
EA version 1.1 has been updated.
We’ve been working on balancing the game for V1.1.
Many characters have been polished and improved as well as one of the bosses has been completely redone. 
We also adjusted Expert difficulty so that it is less dependable on RNG. This means your proficiency and ability is more important in this difficulty.
As for the English translation, we’ve entirely updated and fixed any errors thanks to your feedback!

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*] Overall text has improved
[*] English translation has improved
[*] Save files are now automatically backed up
[/list]

[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]
[b]General[/b]
[list][*] After reaching level 6, extra Soulstones are required to level up.
[*] If a target dies with a Recast skill, it will transfer to another target.
[*] Reduced item randomization in Expert difficulty. This difficulty is now based on a player’s proficiency instead of luck.
[*] Anvil – Increase item's gold consumption based on rarity.
[*] Overpowered equipment has been nerfed.
[/list]

[h2]Bosses[/h2]
[b]Time Eater[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/1ce3a13e77019451c9ff44b1076d88cf2d4d078c.png[/img]
[list][*] The boss has been reworked.
[/list]
[b]The Witch[/b]
[list][*] The encounter is now easier in Normal difficulty
[/list]
[b]Ruby and Sapphire[/b]
[list][*] The bosses now use Blow of Harmony slightly earlier.
[*] The bosses now use one less Cleanse in Expert difficulty.
[/list]

[h2][b]Phoenix[/b][/h2]
[b]Changed the effect of Scratch [/b]
[list][*] Can be cast regardless of hunger level.
If hungry, cast this again (50% chance). Extra chance to cast on an ally (25%).
[/list]

[b]Changed the effect of Blazing Regeneration [/b]
[list][*] Draw a skill and inflict 5 damage to its owner.
This attack ignores healing gauge protection.
All ally healing gauges are restored. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/a93dca1d4fd5e176901cf7cd8c11aceaf51028dc.png[/img]
[h1]New skill, 'I'll Step Out!'[/h1]
[list][*] Drawn when the battle starts.
Cannot be targeted or use fixed abilities this turn. Remove all skills. Recover from hunger.
[/list]


[h2][b]Azar[/b][/h2]
[b]Passive - Hollowed Sword[/b]
A character that uses attack skills will gain Hollowed Sword. A character with multiple attack skills has a higher chance to gain additional Hollowed Sword skills.
[list]
[*] Fantasy: Fantasy drawn by Fantasy will not apply its effect.
[*] Hollowed Sword buffs: Now has 5% increased Accuracy.
[*] Ascending Slice: Now has Ignore Taunt.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/a2dc08d9ae23a9c928ed92a649e24f5582cc0ed2.png[/img]
[b]Extra effect of Blade Starfall[/b]
[list][*] Cast all Hollowed Sword in hand. Targets all enemies.
If facing one enemy, Hollowed Sword will critical strike.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/aeba8cc865c65f6085b8535c30f86328e6fb879a.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Joey[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Chemical Weapon: Now Joey’s intoxication stack limit is 3.
[*] Weakening Smog: Damage has slightly reduced and increases all resist reduction to the target.
[/list]

[h2][b]Hein[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Base accuracy has increased.
[*] Extra effect of Tear Up: Damage is increased by 30% if facing one enemy.
[*] Extra effect of Assault Slash: Increase this skill's accuracy and damage if it targets one enemy.
[/list]

[h2][b]Sizz[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Passive - Doll Eve: Eve can now attack at the start of turn.
[*] Help, Eve!: Barrier rate has decreased from 65% to 60%.
[*] Incise: Attack buff rate has decreased from 60% to 40%, buff duration has increased from 2 turns to 3.
[*] Healing Wave: Healing rate has increased from 75% to 88%.
[*] Sacrifice: Success rate of debuff to make Eve unavailable has decreased from 300% to 66%.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36176731/76f669af7b50e88123004c64d7cfe27c3bf897a1.png[/img]
[h1]New Skill: Time to Move![/h1]
Time to Move! allows Eve to heal twice costing 1 and gain a buff to counter attack.

[h2][b]Silverstein[/b][/h2]
[b]Passive - S.P.O.R.T.S.[/b]
[list][*] Name has changed from Hit That One Point Four.
[*] Additional attacks from passive skills will not shoot if no enemy is present.
[*] Created Skill -> Cannot activate S.P.O.R.T.S. with skills created by other characters.
[*] Additional shot rate has decreased from 35% to 25%.
[/list]

[h2][b]Ironheart[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Double Armor: Now a target who is affected by Double Armor cannot receive Double Armor's effect for 2 turns.
[*] Shield Bash: Damage rate by armor has decreased from 165% to 160%.
[*] Duel: Enemies who are in Duel now cannot target anyone besides Ironheart.
[*] Weapon Breaker: Modified to be used easier.
[*] Not in My Sight: Increased the cost to 2.
[*] Protective Shield: Changed the cost to 3, now has Once Only.
[/list]

[h2][b]Lian[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Come at Me!: Now taunts an enemy and creates skills equal to the number of enemies.
[*] Protect Ally: If Lian's healing gauge is protected, the target gains protection too.
[/list]

[h2][b]Miss Chain[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Bazzuum!: Now has Focus.
[*] Engine Burner: Maximum stack limit of Burnt and Calming Touch has decreased.
[/list]

[h2][b]Charon[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Encroach Debuff: Maximum stack has increased from 3 to 5. Now if a target dies with Encroach, pass it on to a random ally.
[/list]

[h2]Common Skill[/h2]
[list][*] Rash - Attack power has decreased. Debuff success rate has decreased.
[*] Rate of multiple healing skills has decreased
[/list]
